Interface JsonWriter

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
public interface JsonWriter extends AutoCloseable
A streaming writer for one JSON document. Commas and colons are written for you; writing a name outside an object or a second top-level value throws IllegalStateException.

Not thread safe. Output is buffered: flush() pushes it to the underlying stream, and close() flushes and returns the writer's buffers to its backend. Neither closes the underlying stream, which the caller owns. A writer made without a stream keeps the document in memory until toByteArray().
